title: Sony WF-C710N
shortDescription: Noise cancelling, longer battery life, and uncompromised sound quality.
description:
Noise cancelling, longer battery life, and uncompromised sound quality. Get all the features you need in these versatile earbuds.

Advanced Noise Canceling and Dual Noise Sensor technology filters exterior sound using two microphones and allows you to enjoy more of your music.

Features.WF-C710N: Noise cancelling, longer battery life, and uncompromised sound quality. Get all the features you need in these versatile earbuds.
Features.Noise Canceling: Advanced Noise Canceling and Dual Noise Sensor technology filters exterior sound using two microphones and allows you to enjoy more of your music.
Features.Long Battery Life: With up to 8.5 hours on your earbuds and up to 21.5 hours in the case, enjoy all-day comfort and up to 30 hours of listening when fully charged. Quick charging, 5 min charge for up to 1 hour of playback.
Features.Crystal Clear Call Quality: With Precise Voice Pickup Technology, conversations are ultra clear, even in noisy environments. Our noise reduction algorithm uses AI machine learning to suppress ambient noise and extract your voice clearly. Features.Sound Connect APP: Sony | Sound Connect app allows you to adjust the ambient sound in 20 levels or use the Focus on Voice setting to chat without removing your earbuds.
